text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wanting to discuss training, I go to see

Nakayama Festa during her dance
lesson.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Your movements were so sharp
just now! It
looked so cool!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You didn't even fall behind through the
most
difficult part! How do you do it?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, give me a break. We're all basically
on the
same level here.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Or, are you trying to flatter me? Hoping
I'll get
overconfident so you can beat me
in a dance
battle?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: What?! I wasn't thinking that at all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Although, that might be a little fun! We
do have a
lot to learn from you,
Nakayama!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dia?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer. From the sound of it, yup.
choice_data_list: ダンスバトルするのか？
choice_data_list_en: Are you having a dance battle?
Are you having a dance battle?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
No! I mean, we weren't planning that
from the
start or anything.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Kita! We might never get
another
chance like this! Will you battle
with us,
Nakayama?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
R-really? I'm not so sure, but... I guess
you're right
about not missing this
chance. Um, so will you,
Nakayama?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Sure... but don't think I'm gonna go easy
on you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their dance battle begins. They each
improvise
dancing to a song chosen
randomly.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hm, hm, hmmm! ♪ Mmm... Hyah!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: La, la, la! La, la, la! ♪ Aaand... yay!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
We're gonna need to take things up a
notch if
you wanna call this a real battle!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa adjusts her movements
along
with the music.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's amazing to watch. It's like the
feelings in the
song are being expressed
through her body!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: And... that's it!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I knew you were amazing! Even when
improvising,
you matched the song so
well.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Your movements were incredibly natural!
I could
watch you forever.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, would you two stop kissing up
already.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan and Diamond
text_block_list.text: Nakayama, of course!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. Thanks for that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two seem more inspired rather than
upset
that they've lost. On the other
hand, I hear
Nakayama Festa mutter to
herself, "Geez, that
was hard..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes! You were so amazing that I forgot I
had to
compete and completely stopped
to watch you!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama! Will you teach us that
dance?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
What? No... Didn't I already do enough?
C'mon,
man...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Yeah, and that's exactly why... Ugh!
choice_data_list: でも、2人も本当に感動してるし……
choice_data_list_en: Still, both of them are genuinely moved, so...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Nakayama! Wait for us!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa walks off quickly, but I
can tell
she isn't really irritated.
